entries.title: The entire Search page now lives inside the conversation — fully operable
bullets: Loren embeds the real /search page right in the chat, seeded with the filters she parsed (e.g. Aventura + For Sale) — the whole thing: search box, filters, view toggles, results.
It's fully operable inline: you can search, filter, switch views, and open listings without leaving the conversation.
Isolated by design (rendered in a frame with an error boundary), so it can never crash the Loren shell around it.
A Compact view toggle collapses it back to inline cards/table; Open full screen is there if you want the standalone page.
